title: Brief the live optimizer from trusted feedback and explanations
description:
## Behavior and acceptance
Provide an injectable live optimizer interface with a scripted fake. Briefing includes eligible training item content/metadata, trusted votes and comments, errors, current rubric/tasks/examples and version. Do not send audit or scoreboard content, labels, errors or metrics to the optimizer.
Scenario: a vote with an explanation reaches the optimizer briefing; protected partition records do not. Inadequate class coverage is reported as waiting for labels, not silently declared successful optimization.

## Constraints
Native provider-neutral library only; no DSPy. The application does not implement a second flywheel. Optimizer proposes; code validates/applies; numerical fitting alone sets weights and calibration. Training, development, random audit and sealed scoreboard remain separated. No credentials or private article text in committed artifacts. Specs first with fake clients; live calls explicit and budgeted.
